## Summary of Problems Found & Fixes Applied

1. **`body_mass_g` stored as text** — The column was typed as text, with one value written as `"5,500"` (comma-formatted). I cast the column to numeric so it could be averaged. All 53 values parsed successfully with no data lost.

2. **Out-of-range value (row 10)** — Row 10 had `body_mass_g = 4,000,000`, which is far outside the valid range of [2,500, 6,500] grams specified in the rules file. This is clearly an erroneous/impossible value, so I excluded that row from the analysis.

3. **`species` column** — Checked for label variants/misspellings; the column was clean (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo only). No fix needed.

**Caveat:** The analysis used 52 of 53 rows (1 row excluded due to the impossible body mass value). The averages above reflect this.
